entities.summary: Saint Hakob of Akori Monastery, was an Armenian monastery located in the southeastern part of the historic region of Surmalu. The monastery was located 4.7 kilometers southwest of Akori, a village at the northeastern slope of Mount Ararat. Destroyed by an earthquake and lahar in 1840, Akori was later rebuilt. It is known today as Yenidoğan and remains a small Kurdish village.
